summary.text: Austin Peterson is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election and an at-large member of the Hawley Public Schools board.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband, father of three and real estate developer.

paragraphs.text: Peterson said in the survey that he has spent his career building businesses and creating housing and health care projects in rural communities.

He listed keeping jobs and businesses in Minnesota, fighting for rural communities, and bringing a business mindset to St. Paul as his campaign messages, and named economic development as his main policy interest.
His Republican primary was canceled, and he advanced to the general election without appearing on the primary ballot.
